mila: Hey team — nightly-evals spiked on function-call schema parsing for the q8 quantized candidate. 199 failures across the prompt set, mostly schema parse errors. Posting a minimal example we keep seeing.

mila: Example payload that's causing the parser to choke (notice embedded newline in the arg string):
```json
{"tool":"search","args":"[\"multi-line query\\nwith newline\\nembedded\"]"}
```

mila: The downstream JSONL loader treats that as two separate records, so our toolcall deserializer tries to parse an incomplete line and throws. Only happens when model emits a `\\n` literal inside the JSON string instead of `\\\n` (double-escaped).

sam: Interesting — is the model literally emitting a raw newline or the two-character sequence `\\n`?

mila: It's emitting a literal newline in the generated string (not the escape sequence) in several cases. The generation looks like:
```
{
  "tool": "search",
  "args": ["line1\nline2"]
}
```
so our JSONL writer writes two lines.

reza: That explains why jsonlines loader barfs. Does this only happen for q8 pathway? Any difference with fp16 or q4?

mila: We compared logits and sampling logs: q8 model seems to prefer emitting actual newline bytes for long prompts due to a tokenization quirk around the escaped backslash. fp16 and q4 don't show this. Confirmed by running the same prompt across model variants.

alex: Quick triage plan: 1) Add a pre-parse sanitizer that collapses unterminated JSONL lines and attempts to re-join if the next line completes a JSON object (best-effort) 2) Add a generation-side postprocess that replaces raw newlines inside string fields with `\\n` before writing into JSONL 3) Add a nightly regression test to assert no malformed JSONL for tool outputs. Thoughts?

qa-alex: For (2) we should be careful not to mangle legitimate pretty-printed outputs when we expect multi-line text. Maybe only apply to fields that match the tool schema (eg args should be an array of strings).

sam: Agreed. Also we should log the original raw output to S3 (redact secrets) so we can replay exact model emissions for root cause.

mila: I pushed a small hotfix to the eval harness: if a JSON parse fails on a line, attempt to append the next line and reparse up to 3 lines. Deploy-bot: deploy preview/eval-sanitizer to staging?

deploy-bot: deploy preview/eval-sanitizer started — job id e-4912. Will report back on staging results. :gear:

reza: After you validate, let's run the nightly suite for q8-only to see if failure count drops. If it persists, we may need to file an upstream tokenizer bug with the model repo.

mila: I'll run the q8-only sweep and post results. For the long term, we should add a schema-aware emitter wrapper in the runtime so models never write raw newlines into JSONL tool payloads.

sam: +1. Also add an eval alert rule to tag failures caused by malformed JSONL so we can track frequency separately from semantic errors.

mila: Thanks everyone — I'll update the incident ticket with links to failing samples and the staging run once deploy finishes.
